truthLaw: Public self-report and directory evidence can qualify a candidate for owner review, but do not prove demand, white-label willingness, contact permission, legal eligibility, deliverability, payment or willingness to pay.

requiredForOwnerReview: core HVAC, plumbing, electrical or clearly adjacent trade evidence
at least three named downstream examples or an explicit equivalent multi-client operating claim
relevant website, lead-generation, paid-search, conversion, CRM or revenue-operations services

rankingMethod: Research-only ordinal ranking by core vertical fit, lead-path relevance, public multi-client evidence, service adjacency, likely one-to-many leverage and conflict risk. No numeric willingness-to-pay or demand score is inferred.

evidence.claim: Leadhub states that it helps home-service companies acquire, convert and maximize lead opportunities and lists web, PPC, CRM and email capabilities.
The public results index lists multiple named home-service client stories across HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, doors, pest control and related trades.
The case study describes website, SEO, PPC, ServiceTitan Marketing Pro drip campaigns for unsold estimates and lead results for a plumbing client.
The case study describes HVAC replacement-lead work using segmented offers, landing pages, social ads and a ServiceTitan drip campaign.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Strongest public match to the canary's lead-path, CRM and follow-up thesis with a broad named case-study footprint. Direct-service overlap means an independent evidence angle must be proven before any owner-authorized contact.
limitations: All outcome claims are company-published; no buyer-origin confirmation or demand evidence.

namedDownstreamClientExamples: Unnamed Texas client in public SEO case study
rankedCandidates.multiClientEvidenceBasis: BxB's public work-with-us page states it has helped hundreds of home-services companies; this is a company claim, not independently verified customer count.

evidence.claim: BxB presents itself as a home-services marketing agency focused on HVAC and describes work with HVAC, plumbing and electrical professionals.
The public program page lists HVAC, plumbing and electrical programs with website, SEO, ServiceTitan Marketing Pro, paid ads and reporting capabilities.
BxB states it has helped hundreds of home-services companies and describes a team-based client delivery model.
A public case study describes a Texas client receiving a new website and a large increase in first-page keyword rankings.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Best exact vertical match and clear ServiceTitan/website/PPC adjacency. Fewer named public examples than Leadhub, so the multi-client conclusion relies partly on an explicit self-reported volume claim.
limitations: The public case study does not identify the Texas client by name; hundreds-of-companies claim is not independently verified.

evidence.claim: Lemon Seed states that it has worked with hundreds of contractors in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest control and roofing and is exclusive to home services.
The public work index lists multiple home-service brands including Plumbing Outfitters, Perfect Climate Heating & Air and McWilliams Heating.
The branding page lists named HVAC/electrical client work and describes branding, vehicle-wrap and identity services for home-service companies.
Public content addresses open-estimate follow-up, speed-to-lead, tracking and automation for HVAC, plumbing and electrical businesses.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Very strong vertical and portfolio evidence, with public content that makes the open-estimate/revenue-leak problem legible. More brand/creative-led than the first two candidates, so independent evidence value must be explicit.
limitations: Portfolio and hundreds-of-contractors claims are company-published; no buyer-origin demand or willingness-to-pay evidence.

evidence.claim: Hibu publishes an HVAC-specific page describing digital marketing and names Harding Plumbing, Heating & Cooling, Polar Heating & Air and Main Heating and Air as client/result examples.
Hibu states that it specializes in plumbing marketing for small business owners and local franchises.
Hibu maintains a public case-study library for small businesses and home-improvement categories.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Clears the evidence gate with three named HVAC examples and a broad delivery surface, but size, direct overlap and likely procurement complexity reduce near-term canary fit.
limitations: Public evidence does not establish agency partnership appetite or a practical route to a small white-label experiment.

rankedCandidates.multiClientEvidenceBasis: Public 1SEO pages state 500+ successful client relationships; a FieldEdge partner page says the bulk of those clients include HVAC, plumbing and electric companies.

evidence.claim: A public case study describes retargeting, A/B testing and phone/conversion outcomes for Radiant Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning.
The plumbing page states 500+ successful client relationships and describes increased ROI for plumbing clients.
The HVAC service page lists SEO, web design, content and PPC support and states 500+ successful client relationships.
FieldEdge's public partner page describes 1SEO's 500+ clients as including home-service companies such as HVAC, plumbing and electric businesses.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Core vertical and delivery fit are clear, but named public evidence is thin relative to the 500+ volume claim and direct agency overlap is likely. Keep below the more focused trade specialists.
limitations: 500+ client figure is a self-reported equivalent, not a verified named-client count; 1SEO is now presented as part of Scorpion on its site.

evidence.claim: CyberFunnels describes integrated marketing, automated lead response, CRM sales pipeline, follow-up, project management and workforce management for contractors.
The public site names six contractor/client examples and displays case-study categories for several of them.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Excellent public evidence for lead-to-close systems and one-to-many contractor work, but the visible vertical mix is remodeling, roofing and pools rather than the core HVAC/plumbing/electrical canary.
limitations: Adjacent contractor evidence does not establish core-trade specialization or a white-label route.

evidence.claim: The public site describes an AI-powered growth platform for turf businesses with scheduling, marketing, follow-up and reviews and says dozens of turf installers use it.
The about page describes long sales cycles, seasonal demand, multiple crews and workflows from leads through scheduling and follow-up.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: The workflow evidence is highly relevant to missed follow-up, but the company is a turf-specific software/operator brand and could directly overlap with the proposed evidence product.
limitations: No core-trade evidence; dozens and outcome claims are company-published; no demand or partnership evidence.

evidence.claim: The public portfolio lists multiple named clients and client-linked projects across landscaping and green-industry businesses and suppliers.
The public site describes website content, internet marketing and ghost-blog writing for the landscape/lawn-care market.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Clear multi-client content operation, but the public evidence is green-industry focused and does not support the core HVAC/plumbing/electrical canary.
limitations: No core-trade evidence; some portfolio entries are suppliers or partner publications rather than downstream contractor accounts.

evidence.claim: The public site positions Green Frog as a lawn and landscaping marketing agency offering web design, SEO and PPC.
The website-design page names Lattimer Lawns as a case study and describes lead-oriented website work.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: Relevant service surface, but the public pass found only one named client example and no core-trade evidence.
limitations: Do not promote on a generic agency label or one case study.

evidence.claim: The public site describes a revenue-share growth partner for service businesses with brand, marketing and sales-enablement capabilities.

rankedCandidates.rankRationale: The revenue-share mechanism is economically interesting, but the public pass found no core-trade specialization and no three-client/equivalent public operating evidence.
limitations: One generic testimonial or growth claim is not enough to qualify an agency partner.

decision.recommendedNextResearch: Run a second public pass on the top three for independent corroboration of identity, current service scope, public client examples and any evidence of partner/reseller/white-label norms. Keep all contact and outbound gates closed.
decision.commercialConclusion: This receipt improves target qualification but does not create buyer demand, a qualified conversation, payment, delivery, acceptance or revenue.
